stops.name: Königssee
stops.detail: From the Kehlstein, Berchtesgaden looks more like an Upper Bavarian village than a market town with just under 8,000 inhabitants. Between the curved flow of the “Königsseer Ache” river and the wooded slopes of Kälberstein and Lockstein mountains, houses and alleys lie in a narrow strip.
